description.en:
Kuavo is LEJU's full-size humanoid platform family for research, intelligent services and industrial development. The family is positioned as an open platform for teams building embodied-intelligence applications, with research, data collection and model services forming part of the wider ecosystem. LEJU identifies factory work, logistics, showroom guidance and customer-facing assistance among its application areas.

The current portfolio includes the KUAVO 5 bipedal and 5-W wheeled-arm configurations. This catalog entry describes the Kuavo family; dimensions, mobility, manipulation hardware and development interfaces should be checked against the selected generation rather than treated as identical across all Kuavo robots.
